I don't receive any 2FA, wait a minute and hit enter and get this error.
Going to  the gsa link in a browser gives me a `Error code: 403 Forbidden` even though I am logged into iCould on this browser. 



Trying to log into iCloud on a web browser wile logging the traffic showed that Apple right now seems to do a PUT request to `https://idmsa.apple.com/appleauth/auth/verify/phone`.
It sends it:
```{"phoneNumber":{"id":1},"mode":"sms"}```
and then the verification code goes as a POST to `https://idmsa.apple.com/appleauth/auth/verify/phone/securitycode`
with the following content:
```{"phoneNumber":{"id":1,"nonFTEU":true},"securityCode":{"code":"123456"},"mode":"sms"}```

  [2026-02-09T07:05:02Z] @tinydream96: If you are struggling with setting this up or need to perform a clean start to fix the 401 error, I've created a helper script [Macless Haystack Installer](https://github.com/tinydream96/macless-haystack-installer) that might be useful.  

It automates the deployment of macless-haystack and anisette-v3 and includes a "Clean Install" option. This feature automatically removes all related containers and volumes to ensure a completely fresh environment, which is often recommended to resolve these authentication issues. It also handles the interactive login process for you.

You can try it out with this single command:

Hope this makes the troubleshooting process easier!
  [2026-02-09T07:06:29Z] @tinydream96: @mehrlich69 Regarding the issue where no data/coordinates are returned despite successful authentication:

We've observed that this is often due to Apple strictly blocking Data Center/VPS IP addresses from accessing the Find My data endpoints. Even if the login works perfectly and you get a 200 OK status, the search endpoint may return an empty list if the request originates from a known cloud provider (like AWS, DigitalOcean, etc.).

We have detailed this behavior and potential solutions (like using residential IPs) in our troubleshooting guide: 👉 [Troubleshooting: No Location Data (0 reports)](https://github.com/tinydream96/macless-haystack-installer/blob/main/troubleshooting_empty_reports_en.md)
